Welcome to FLUID SPACE

A keyboard, an ambient effects rack, and a performance recorder.

  1. Start instrument. Your fixed 142 MiB sound library loads on first use.
  2. Choose a track and sound. Play with a MIDI keyboard, touch, or the computer keys.
  3. Open Sequencer. Set the selected track’s measure length and choose Replace or Overdub.
  4. Press Record. Wait for the count-in. Replace captures one pass; Overdub keeps adding layers until you press Record again.
  5. Build another scene. Copy a scene and rerecord parts, or select an empty scene. The eight instruments stay the same.

Each track repeats at its own length. Scene changes start all eight parts together on the next measure. Effect tails continue.

Work saves automatically on this device. Save project downloads a backup that you can open on another device. Effects and complete instrument patches can also be saved locally.

Export audio creates a stereo WAV of the current scene or all recorded scenes in numerical order. Choose a measure count, repeats, 16- or 24-bit resolution, and a tail for your delay and reverb, then render and download. Finish recording first. Export uses the current mix, including mute and solo.

Shortcuts: Space = play/stop · R = record · Escape = all sound off · 1–8 = scenes · Z/X = keyboard octave.

SoundFont: Fluid R3 GM, Frank Wen. Playback engine: SpessaSynth · License. This is a browser instrument, not a native DAW plug-in.

STEREO MIXDOWN

Export audio

Render your recorded parts with the current instruments, mix, delay, and reverb. Count-in and metronome stay out of the file.

Live freeze is released for export so the recorded notes can feed the reverb. The held live tail is not part of the recording.

STEREO WAV—

Download WAV

Keep this tab open while rendering. Export starts at the scene’s first beat; shorter tracks repeat at their own lengths. Added tails fade out at the end. With no tail, a 5 ms fade prevents clicks.
